sections.excerpt: 01 — PROFILE NAME Muhammad Haerul, S.Kom ROLE AI Full-Stack Specialist (Engineer, Researcher, and Trainer) EDUCATION Bachelor of Computer Science EXPERIENCE 4+ years in AI and Data Science AREA OF EXPERTISE Artificial Intelligence Application Data Analytics Computer Vision Natural Language Processing Generative AI AI Agents AI Full-Stack Specialist with 4 Years of Experiences My work sits at the intersection of AI engineering, applied research, product development, and education technology. I develop end-to-end AI solutions, from data preparation and model development to application integration and deployment, while exploring new approaches to make AI more practical, reliable, and impactful. Beyond engineering, I help individuals and organizations understand, adopt, and apply AI through training, mentorship, and hands-on learning. I enjoy bridging the gap between AI research and real-world implementation, translating emerging technologies into useful products and empowering people to use AI with confidence. My experience spans industry, public-sector digital transformation, and AI education, with a particular interest in responsible AI, data, and technology that addresses meaningful challenges. My mission is to build, research, and teach AI solutions that create real value — building intelligent systems and dependable software architectures that ship to make AI more accessible, practical, and impactful for people, businesses, and society.
